sample_unit: participants (raters) evaluating TILs on 60 H&E melanoma sections
models_evaluated: Machine learning algorithm for TIL quantification in melanoma

links.outcome: Interobserver reproducibility of TIL scoring, manual pathologist arm vs AI-assisted arm
links.effect: AI-assisted ICCs >0.90 for all ML TIL variables vs manual Clark TIL Kendall W 0.44; ICC 0.61 for AI-derived stromal TILs. Overreliance not assessed.
links.quote: The AI algorithm demonstrated superior reproducibility, with ICCs higher than 0.90 for all machine learning TIL variables, significantly outperforming manual assessments (ICC, 0.61 for AI-derived stromal TILs vs Kendall W, 0.44 for manual Clark TIL scoring).

screen.reason: Evaluates an AI-driven digital pathology tool for TIL quantification in melanoma across multiple operators (reader study) compared to manual pathologist assessment.
